description: Pure-managed C# HTTP client for the Databento Historical API. Covers timeseries (DBN binary and JSON), metadata, batch jobs, and symbology. No native dependencies — works on any .NET 8+ runtime.
releaseNotes:
v2.1.0 — 2026-10-07

Added
- DefinitionRecordJson: the 54 fields the API sends that weren't mapped (currencies, lot and trade-size
  limits, maturity parts, UnderlyingId, RawInstrumentId, the DBN v3 Leg* fields, and more).
- ImbalanceRecordJson.AuctionTime, DateRange.Schemas (SchemaRange), SymbologyResolution.Message / Status,
  UnitPriceInfo.UnitPrices and DatasetCondition.Date.

Fixed
- GetDatasetCondition with a date returned the dataset's first day; it now returns the requested day
  (null for a day without an entry), and the most recent day when no date is given.
- ListConditions always failed with 404; it now calls metadata.get_dataset_condition.

Deprecated (to be removed in the next major version)
- GetSymbolMappings (no symbol_mapping schema; use ResolveSymbols) and GetOhlcvEod (no dataset serves
  ohlcv-eod; use GetOhlcv1d).
- Properties the API never sends: UnitPriceInfo.UnitPrice, DatasetCondition.DateGenerated,
  PublisherInfo.Name, FieldInfo.Description, and TsInDelta / Depth / Sequence on the BBO, tcbbo and
  cmbp-1 records (JSON and DBN).

v2.0.1 — 2026-10-07

Fixed
- ResolveSymbols returned every interval with Symbol, StartDate and EndDate null: the API sends
  them as s, d0 and d1. EndDate is the exclusive end of the interval.

v2.0.0 — 2026-10-06

Breaking (public property types, required by the fixes below)
- StatisticsRecordJson.Quantity and StatisticsRecordDbn.Quantity: int -> long.
- StatusRecordJson.Action, Reason and TradingEvent: string -> ushort, matching StatusRecordDbn.

Fixed
- ResolveSymbols resolved only the last symbol of a multi-symbol request: symbols now travel in
  one comma-joined field, as symbology.resolve keeps only the last of repeated fields.
- Statistics (JSON) threw on any 64-bit quantity, including INT64_MAX for "no quantity".
- Statistics (DBN) misread every field after price on DBN v3 data (80-byte records); both the
  v3 and the older layout are now decoded, chosen by record length.
- Status (JSON) threw on every record: action, reason and trading_event are numeric codes.
- Definitions (DBN) misread the strike and instrument class in DBN v1 (360-byte records) and
  almost every field in DBN v3 (520-byte records); both layouts are now decoded, verified
  against live records, and any other length is refused instead of misread.
- DefinitionRecordJson.Action was always null: the API names the field security_update_action.
- Undefined DBN timestamps (u64::MAX) now decode as null rather than a bogus date.

v1.4.0 — 2026-09-17

Added
- DatabentoOptions.RequestCompressedResponses (default true) to turn response compression off.

Changed
- Requests now negotiate a compressed response: the client sends Accept-Encoding and the runtime
  decodes the Content-Encoding the API answers with, transparently, before the body reaches the
  caller. Market data is highly repetitive, so a timeseries response is substantially smaller on
  the wire - one session of option CBBO measured 117 KB uncompressed against 8.1 KB gzipped.
- DownloadBatchFileAsync is exempt and negotiates nothing, so a stored artifact is delivered
  exactly as stored rather than being decoded in flight.

v1.3.0 — 2026-09-17

Added
- JSON records returned by timeseries.get_range now expose the raw Symbol they belong to,
  populated from the API's map_symbols field. Covers every timeseries schema: bbo, cbbo,
  cmbp-1, definition, imbalance, mbo, mbp-1, mbp-10, ohlcv, statistics, status, tbbo,
  tcbbo and trades.

Changed
- A timeseries request covering more than one symbol (or ALL_SYMBOLS) now sends
  map_symbols=true, so an interleaved response can be split per symbol without a second
  symbology call. A single-symbol request is unchanged and does not send it: the caller
  already knows the symbol and the field is repeated on every record.

v1.2.2 — 2026-06-15

Fixed
- JSON client returned zero records for responses whose numeric fields are string-encoded
  (pretty_px=true, e.g. "price":"4.000000000"): such values now read into the numeric DTO
  properties via JsonNumberHandling.AllowReadingFromString.
- A record that fails to deserialize now throws DatabentoException instead of being silently
  dropped, so a parse failure can no longer masquerade as an empty result.

Added
- Symbol package (.snupkg) + Source Link for step-into debugging.

v1.2.1 — 2026-06-13 (docs/metadata update; no API changes)
See v1.2.0 below for the full feature release.

v1.2.0 — 2026-06-13

Added
- DatabentoJsonClient: full Historical API JSON coverage — new schemas: mbo, mbp-10,
  bbo-1s, bbo-1m, tbbo, tcbbo, cmbp-1, status, imbalance, symbol_mapping; new metadata
  endpoints: list_conditions, get_record_count, get_billable_size, get_cost.
- DatabentoClient (DBN binary): full schema coverage — MboRecordDbn, Mbp10RecordDbn,
  TbboRecordDbn, TcbboRecordDbn, Cmbp1RecordDbn, BboRecordDbn, StatusRecordDbn,
  ImbalanceRecordDbn, StatisticsRecordDbn, DefinitionRecordDbn, SymbolMappingRecordDbn.
- Adaptive MBO body layout: handles DBN v1 (40-byte, no channel_id) and v2 (48-byte).

Fixed
- TBBO decoder now accepts rtype 0x01 (Mbp1) as sent by the live Databento API.

Full history: https://github.com/mrut2pac/Databento.CSharpApiClient/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
